metadata.description: Curated directory of primary discovery feeds and event aggregators for Vancouver events under $50 CAD. These sources serve as discovery funnels only; candidate events must resolve to verified canonical ticket providers.

sources.name: Vancouver Is Awesome
sources.focus: Community culture, trending local happenings, weekend roundups, seasonal festivals
sources.resolutionPolicy: Extract candidate title and venue; follow outbound link to primary ticketing or box office portal. Never use VIA article URL as final card destination.

sources.name: Do604
sources.focus: Live music, cover bands, indie rock, DJ & retro dance nights, brewery trivia, comedy, and RSVP giveaways
sources.resolutionPolicy: Extract outbound 'Buy Tickets' / 'More Info' redirect button to retrieve canonical ticketing platform (Showpass, Ticketweb, Eventbrite, Dice).

sources.name: The Georgia Straight
sources.focus: Grassroots arts, live theatre, dance, jazz sessions, comedy showcases, and community submissions
sources.resolutionPolicy: Parse submitted organizer contact/ticket links and resolve to official venue box office or independent ticketing site.

sources.name: Daily Hive Vancouver
sources.focus: Weekly 'Free & cheap things to do in Vancouver' roundups, night markets, food festivals, and seasonal pop-ups
sources.resolutionPolicy: Scan weekly weekend editorial lists, extract venue and dates, and resolve to official venue pages.

sources.name: Miss604 (Rebecca Bollwitt)
sources.focus: Civic gatherings, free outdoor festivals, park events, farmers markets, heritage and community activities
sources.resolutionPolicy: Extract structured bullet points from weekly 'Things to Do in Vancouver This Weekend' post published every Thursday; link directly to official host organization.

sources.name: Destination Vancouver
sources.focus: Major city-wide street festivals (Khatsahlano, Car Free Days, Greek Day, Italian Day), fireworks, cultural celebrations
sources.resolutionPolicy: High authority; use official festival domains and municipal event landing pages linked on each listing.

sources.name: Live Music Vancouver
sources.focus: Vancouver bar and pub live music circuit (The Roxy, Blarney Stone, Rickshaw, LanaLou's, Fairview)
sources.resolutionPolicy: Extract gig date and performer, then match to venue's official ticket portal or verified door policy.

sources.name: Songkick Vancouver
sources.focus: Live band tours, local venue shows, cover showcases, recurring club gigs
sources.resolutionPolicy: Extract platform ticketing links (Ticketweb, Eventbrite, AXS, Showpass) and calculate all-in fees.

sources.name: Bandsintown Vancouver
sources.focus: Concerts, emerging artists, local stage performances across Metro Vancouver
sources.resolutionPolicy: Follow primary ticket provider link to obtain actual cart price and fee breakdown.

sources.name: Showpass Discover (Vancouver)
sources.focus: Independent comedy, dance parties, community performances, seasonal attractions (e.g. Fox Cabaret, Bloedel, Little Mountain Gallery)
sources.resolutionPolicy: Zero middleman: event is already on Showpass; query API directly for instant price verification.

sources.name: Eventbrite Vancouver
sources.focus: Free community workshops, underground music, indie showcases, pop-up markets, neighborhood festivals
sources.resolutionPolicy: Filter for free or <= $50 CAD events; verify organizer reputation against known venue whitelist.

sources.name: Resident Advisor (Vancouver)
sources.focus: Electronic music, dance parties, club nights, warehouse fundraisers, DJ sets, underground community parties
sources.resolutionPolicy: Query RA GraphQL API directly with Vancouver Area ID 39; filter for verified venue locations under $50 CAD total out-of-pocket.

sources.name: TicketWeb (Vancouver)
sources.focus: Indie rock, punk, metal, retro dance parties, touring live acts (Hollywood Theatre, Rickshaw, Wise Hall, Pearl)
sources.resolutionPolicy: Extract live Schema.org offers or venue event mirror; calculate exact all-in total with service fees and 5% GST; quarantine if > $50 CAD.

sources.name: DICE (Vancouver)
sources.focus: Indie showcases, electronic, synth-pop, underground dance parties (Red Gate, Paradise)
sources.resolutionPolicy: Parse __NEXT_DATA__ event payload; verify upfront all-in pricing with zero hidden checkout fees.

sources.name: Shotgun (Vancouver)
sources.focus: Electronic, techno, house, warehouse collectives, late-night parties
sources.resolutionPolicy: Parse live event state and calculate platform commission and 5% GST; enforce <= $50 cap.

sources.name: Spektrix Performing Arts (The Cultch / PuSh)
sources.focus: Contemporary theatre, dance, circus, festival performances across York, Historic, and Culture Lab stages
sources.resolutionPolicy: Extract accessible tiers (Under-30, Youth, Arts Worker, Preview) and verify with 5% GST.

sources.name: Tessitura (VSO / Arts Club / Bard on the Beach)
sources.focus: Symphony concerts, major theatre productions, Shakespeare festival previews, youth/student rush
sources.resolutionPolicy: Filter for accessible rush tiers (Student Rush, Under-35 Symphony Pass, previews) under $50 all-in.

sources.name: Ticket Tailor (Vancouver)
sources.focus: DIY concerts, craft fairs, drag shows, queer dances, community workshops
sources.resolutionPolicy: Parse transparent low flat fees and calculate verified total out-of-pocket price.

sources.name: Zeffy (Vancouver Non-Profits)
sources.focus: Charity choir concerts, heritage walking tours, museum talks, community arts fundraisers
sources.resolutionPolicy: Confirm $0 platform fee; verify 100% transparent admission for Canadian registered non-profits.

sources.name: Humanitix (Vancouver)
sources.focus: Community storytelling, environmental symposiums, local speaker panels, education
sources.resolutionPolicy: Extract transparent charity booking fee and calculate all-in checkout amount.

sources.name: Universe (Vancouver)
sources.focus: DOXA Documentary Film Festival, Latin American Film Festival, food & craft beverage tastings
sources.resolutionPolicy: Parse embedded state or Schema.org offers; enforce <= $50 total checkout.

sources.name: VTix Online (Vancouver)
sources.focus: Hollywood Theatre special showcases, Shadbolt Centre performances, indie theatre and dance
sources.resolutionPolicy: Extract Schema.org JSON-LD offers or table rates; verify exact fees and taxes.

sources.name: Vancouver Civic Theatres
sources.focus: Live theatre, musicals, opera, ballet, symphonic concerts, and comedy showcases at Queen Elizabeth Theatre, Orpheum, Annex, and Vancouver Playhouse
sources.resolutionPolicy: Harvest live calendar from civic API and resolve outbound ticketing provider (Ticketmaster, VTix, AdmitOne, or box office). Strictly enforce <= $50 CAD cap.

sources.name: Broadway Across Canada (Vancouver)
sources.focus: Touring Broadway musicals and major theatrical spectacles hosted at Queen Elizabeth Theatre
